Chapter 562: Chapter 12: Hang in There, I’ll Go Through the Shuttle (Subscribe Please)_2

But unfortunately, Hunyi did not do as he had hoped.

“Caught up?”

Lin Yuan glanced back.

He couldn’t help but frown.

With his current strength, he was confident in defending against millions of Spatial Layer experts, but Hunyi had opened more than thirty million layers.

Not only was he the strongest Ninth Rank lifeform of the current Tianyu Clan, but even amongst the entire Cosmic Starry Skies, there were few who could suppress Hunyi at the Ninth Rank level.

...

Even if Lin Yuan was confident, he did not believe he could stop Hunyi.

At least for the next fifty years, Lin Yuan did not have the confidence to defeat Hunyi.

“Now this is trouble.”

Lin Yuan’s expression darkened.

Though he was just an Avatar of the Primordial Spirit and his death wouldn’t be a significant loss to his True Body, which could be recondensed in a short period of time,

what about the three Ninth-tier Secret Treasures he carried, as well as the many gains since he entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm? Wouldn’t they all be in vain?

The most critical point was the waste of time.

The opening time of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was only a hundred years, and to ensure enough round-trip time, Lin Yuan had to enter the core area within fifty years.

Then he would use another fifty years to return to the periphery, waiting for the closure of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm before being expelled to the Main Universe.

Before the closure of the Secret Realm, any life not in the outer area would be left inside and then perish.

Now that the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had been open for over twenty years, if this Avatar of Lin Yuan died at the hands of Hunyi, it would essentially declare his exploration of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm’s “call” a failure.

Unless Lin Yuan had no intention of returning from the core area at all.

But if he obtained some treasure through the ‘call’ from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and didn’t return to the Main Universe, wouldn’t he just have to wait for the next opening of the Secret Realm?

Given the opening frequency of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which was once every two hundred thousand years… Two hundred thousand years later, with Lin Yuan’s growth speed, even the strongest weapon would be practically useless.

…

Behind him,

Hunyi felt extremely pleased.

He had found what he sought where he least expected it, effortlessly.

He had been worried about the treasures of the opportunity site being taken by the figure in the black robe, but then he promptly discovered the Galaxy Master’s trail.

Galaxy Master!

This was an absolute shadow in the hearts of the Eighth Layer beings of the Tianyu Clan.

Everything that happened in the Battlefields of Different Races, with the Tianyu Clan’s Eighth Layer invincibles butchered by the Galaxy Master like chickens, utterly shattered the spirits of some Eighth Layer beings.

Dying at the hands of a Ninth Rank powerhouse or due to some “external force” wasn’t unusual.

But dying to the same Eighth Layer Galaxy Master, and in such a manner… it was starting to demoralize the Tianyu Clan.

Therefore, in this Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Hunyi put seeking the site of opportunity aside for the time being, making the killing of the Galaxy Master his top priority.

…..

“Galaxy Master, if you stop now, I can give you a swift end,” Hunyi said while closing the distance and transmitting his voice.

In fact, in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the stronger the being, the greater the restrictions they faced.

For example, in the Main Universe, with Hunyi’s strength, he could catch up to Xilan Lin Yuan in a few moments with his instantaneous movements.

But in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, where such instantaneous movements were not possible and even the ultimate speed was capped at the limit of ‘light speed’,

Hunyi could only maintain the distance between him and Xilan Lin Yuan, slowly closing in by dominating the Spatial Layers.

During this time, the pursued could not slip away from his occupied Spatial Layers, otherwise, the chase would have to start all over again.

But Hunyi didn’t mind, for he was still sure he could catch up with Xilan Lin Yuan, even if it took a little longer.

“Stop willingly?”

Lin Yuan certainly wasn’t about to give in, he raised his right hand, mobilizing the Dao of the World and numerous Spatial Layers, and launched a strike at Hunyi coming from behind.

“Galaxy Master, even if I stood still and let you attack as a newly ascended Ninth Rank…”

Hunyi grinned, utterly unconcerned.

As a Ninth Rank powerhouse who had opened more than thirty million layers, Hunyi was extremely confident in the thickness of his life force.

Any attack would be scattered and neutralized by the over thirty million layers, so how much power would actually hit his body?

However—

When Lin Yuan’s attack hit Hunyi, the latter’s expression slightly changed.

“An all-out strike equivalent to at least two million Spatial Layers?” Hunyi found it unbelievable, not because he had sustained any injury.

It was that Lin Yuan’s full-powered strike had such immense might; how long had he been in the Ninth Rank? Where other lifeforms newly ascended to the Ninth Rank were still mastering their control over multiple Spatial Layers, and yet Lin Yuan was already capable of unleashing such a powerful blow?

Hunyi was full of incredulity, and his desire to kill Lin Yuan intensified.

This freak of a prodigy, who knew how much future harm he might cause the Tianyu Clan? He had to kill this Avatar to delay his growth.

…

“It’s no use…”

Lin Yuan realized that his all-out strike did not affect Hunyi at all and immediately understood that, on his own, he couldn’t stop the opponent.

“What should we do?” Xilan also grew anxious.

After all, he carried many treasures with him.

“Should we split up? Hunyi’s target is me,” Lin Yuan suggested.

“Galaxy Master, what do you mean by that?” Xilan immediately frowned, “A mere Avatar is not that big of a deal; do you think I, Xilan, can’t afford the loss?”

“That’s also true.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Even if they split up, Xilan would not be able to escape.

Being seen and hunted by a powerful being like Hunyi, who had locked onto the aura, meant there was no escape as long as they were in this Secret Realm.
